description: Order-book snapshot for ONE Polymarket outcome token: the nearest full-book snapshot at or before `ts` (the latest when omitted), flattened to price levels. `token_id` is the ERC-1155 OUTCOME token id (decimal string from `clob_token_ids` in polymarket_market_detail or `outcomes[].token_id` in polymarket_markets); a condition_id (0x...) will NOT work. Returns rows {as_of_ts (epoch ms, the snapshot actually used), side ('ask' | 'bid'), level (1 = best), price (probability in [0, 1]), size (shares)}, all asks before all bids. A book can be one-sided, so fewer than 2 x depth rows is normal. A level can repeat in one answer (the recorder writes several identical snapshot rows for one venue timestamp): keep one row per (side, level) and read a side's depth as its highest level, never as a row count. `as_of_ts` can be old for a quiet or finished market, so check it before quoting a spread. [] means no snapshot at or before `ts`, or a token that was never recorded.

token_id.description: Required. The outcome token id (decimal string).

ts.description: As-of epoch MILLISECONDS; the nearest snapshot at or before it is used. Omit for the latest.
